features.title: Built for the way you actually job hunt.
features.subtitle: No bloated AI gimmicks. Just the tools you need to ship a great résumé in an afternoon.
features.refinedTemplatesBody: Modern, classic, creative, minimal, bold, academic. All ATS-tested, all printable.
features.dragDropBody: Reorder, swap to two columns, change density. Live preview, no page-break surprises.
features.pixelPdfBody: Embedded fonts, real kerning, A4 or Letter. The same file every recruiter sees.
features.colorTypeBody: Tune palettes, fonts, spacing — bounded by sensible defaults you can't break.
features.cloudSyncBody: Up to {max} résumés, autosaved, versioned. Switch devices without losing a draft.
features.freeBody: No paywall, no upsell, no upsold features. We just want you to land the role.

templates.subtitle: Scroll to browse — the rows drift in opposite directions as you move down the page. Every template is ATS-tested and printable.

cta.subtitle: Pick a template, add your story, export the PDF — in under ten minutes. No signup wall, no upsell, no catch.
